name: signal-iptv
description: Signal IPTV – M3U live TV player with TV guide, packaged for Android with Capacitor

scripts.android:init: npm run copy-hls && npx cap add android && npx capacitor-assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor '#0f1115' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#0f1115' --splashBackgroundColor '#0f1115' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#0f1115'
scripts.android:sync: npm run copy-hls && npx cap sync android
